description: This file contains utility functions for color formatting, including opacity calculations, color function generation based on conditional formatting rules, and memoized color formatter creation for a data visualization project.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified precision.

methods.name: getOpacity
methods.description: Calculates opacity based on value relative to cutoff and extreme values.

methods.name: getColorFunction
methods.description: Generates a color function based on conditional formatting rules and column values.

methods.name: getColorFormatters
methods.description: Creates memoized color formatters for multiple conditional formatting configurations.
